title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Dua For growing beard quickly 17303 views Q. asalamualaykum mufti sahab, Like many other brothers, i have been reading the book "Hizbul Aazam" by Mulla Ali Qari Rahmatullhalay. I read the english translation. I have the following questions regarding the book: 1. Ideally, the supplications should be in arabic, but as i dont understand arabic is it still ok to read the supplications from the book in english? 2. On what grounds is it justified to recite specific prayers on specific days? One of my friends asked me this question and i had no answer so i told him i will get one shortly. Jazakallahu khaire. 2398 views Q. Dua 2931 views Q. I am a teenaged girl. Im getting many proposals. But i'm very strict about getting only a good pious husband who is also fully into da'wat and also a family in which i can hold steadfast onto deeni principles. So all are being wiped off and my parents are getting more anxious and tensed and therefore angry with. CAn you suggest any dua for such a spouse and to get married soon. 2345 views Q. Dua 1994 views Q. Please provide me the dua for getting married 2203 views Q. asalamyalykum, 1) My niyat is to start business as soon as possible becasue i am doing job for this reason i do not pray juma salah and other many fard salah, the month of holy ramzan is coming please sugest me any dua or amal by which allah help me lot, and i start any halal business and pray for me. asalamulykum. 2) if one did not recite dua'y quonot in third rakat of witer prayer, and in the state of jalsa in third rakat his mind remind him that he did not recite dua'y quonot in this rakat while his is reciting darood shrief or while he is reciting dua alahuma inni zalamtumafsi... what he do ? sajda sahu or again repray witer salah.. 1804 views Q. I would like to know in details about so-called Islamic treatment done by various AMILs like: 1. Hazira (sometimes by Zin to collect information whether a Black-Magic is done on someone). Is there any validity of using Zin? 2. Estekhara to find out Black-magic done on something 3. Using Taweez, words of Quran, Numerical signs represing quranic verses etc. If, these are valid - then should one go for such treatments even after reciting Surah Falaq, Surah Naas, Surah Ikhlas, Surah Kafirun 3 times a day - in the morning, after Maghrib Salaah and before sleeping? 3843 views Q. Dua for Meiner Disease 13542 views Q. جب کبھی میں بزنس شرو ع کرتاہوں اور کامیابی کا وقت قریب ہوتاہے تو ہر چیز غلط ہوجاتی ہے، اور میں کئی مرتبہ ناکام ہوچکا ہوں 1443 views Q. I want to ask that wazifah is allow in Islam. Kindly provide any reference of Quran and Hadith. 4975 views Q. mastuburation 4420 views Q. Duwa for getting things easy and good health of mother and child during and after ceserian delivery 4247 views Q. I recently got a forwarded email which say Tasbih should not be performed on Left hand (Using fingers to cound number of tasbihat) Is it true ? or I am okay to use both hands for counting tasbihat. 6462 views Q. (May Peace,Mercy & Blessings of Allah (swt) be on all Muslims) (Q.1) Can we do Dua through the wasila of Muhammed(SAW).? (Please reply in the light of Quran & Sahih Hadith with references) 2051 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 11282 Country: India Title: Assalamualaikum. I did Istekhara for my marriage purpose but getting negative outcome so refuse proposal but still personally I am interested so its possible that I do Istekhara again in this regards. I had asked here Mufti Saheb he told me Istekhara is Sunnah. If you did Istekhara and got negative outcome although for same rista you can do Istekhara again and again theirs no limitation for it. Please reply earlier Wassalam. Question: Assalamualaikum.
